sources.title: DGHS Measles Outbreak Monitoring Bulletin, 3 Nov 2026

quotes.text: Six more children died from suspected measles infections in Bangladesh in the 24 hours until 8am today (3 November), taking the combined toll of suspected and laboratory-confirmed measles-related deaths to 1,263.
Vaccine stockouts, discontinued vaccination campaigns, and coverage overestimation likely contributed to Bangladesh’s largest recorded measles outbreak.

At mobile operators' demands, the Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission (BTRC) has proposed extending spectrum allocation tenures from 15 to 20 years.

sources.title: Daily Star: BTRC spectrum renewal bill

quotes.text: The telecom regulator is seeking to raise the spectrum renewal bill for Grameenphone, Robi and Banglalink to around Tk 21,250 crore under a revised plan to extend their licence period to 20 years.
In its earlier proposal made on October 15, the regulator had recommended cutting spectrum prices by 10-30 percent, bringing the total renewal cost to around Tk 13,100 crore.
The proposal covers 79.2 megahertz (MHz) of spectrum in the 900MHz, 1800MHz and 2100MHz bands held by the three operators.

sources.title: Financial Express: AMTOB spectrum pricing request

quotes.text: The Association of Mobile Telecom Operators of Bangladesh (AMTOB) has sought a further reduction in proposed spectrum renewal prices, arguing that the cost of renewing licences for 900 MHz, 1800 MHz, and 2100 MHz bands should be determined by long-term investment needs rather than a simple extension of the existing pricing formula.
